label: Probe: does an entity slot resolve a name? (2 actions)

p.WFCommentActionText:
PROBE. Run it once, with any shortcut name you have.

The Open card below is given TEXT (Shortcut Input) where the editor would put a picked shortcut. Run Shortcut resolves a plain name through WFWorkflowName, and the question is whether an App Intents entity slot does the same.

  Opens the named shortcut -> a name resolves, and Library-Open drops from three cards to one.
  Errors or does nothing  -> find-then-act stays, which is what Use-Shortcut already does.

Either way, say which happened.
